summary.text: Mike Henderson, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 3 (Crawford, St. Francois, Ste. Genevieve, Washington and part of Jefferson counties); he was elected in 2024.
He chairs the Senate Local Government, Elections and Pensions Committee and served in the Missouri House from 2017 to 2025, including as Speaker Pro Tem.

paragraphs.text: Henderson graduated from high school in Jackson, Missouri, in 1978 and received his bachelor's degree from Murray State University in 1982, a master's degree from Southeast Missouri State in 1990 and a specialist certificate in 1992.
He worked as an educator and administrator from 1983 to 2014, serving as both a public school teacher and a coach.
He represented St. Francois County (District 117) in the House from 2017 to 2025 and was Speaker Pro Tem from 2023 to 2025.
Born in Cape Girardeau, he lives in Desloge with his wife, Cheri; they have two children and one grandson.
